protocol.hypothesis: Phase2 preserved valid-looking main values. Repair only strong proxy-consensus contradictions in otherwise valid main measurements.
protocol.fixed_rule: Main correctness posterior < .1 with contamination prior .05, and |raw - posterior mean| > 3 posterior SD; replace with posterior mode. Leave all other values unchanged.
protocol.gate: Both seeds delta > 0.001 and paired 95% CI lower > 0
protocol.compute: One extra frozen reference classifier, no new model search. Stop at weak screening.
protocol.history: Final bounded hypothesis after negative phase3 routes. Only fold-local X fits repairs; no label alterations, independent blind test, or measured Kaggle score.
